Plugin.Name: bongIT Theme
Plugin.Overview:
A calm light and dark theme for the Unraid webGUI in the bongIT house style (petrol, paper, red). CSS only, no services or binaries: it adds its own stylesheet to the webGUI and leaves Unraid's theme files untouched (the login page and the log window get a small marked block that is removed on uninstall).
- Light, dark or automatic (follows the device) – each browser chooses with the button in the toolbar; without a choice Unraid's colour scheme applies (White = light, Black = dark). - Header with a circuit-board pattern or your own banner images (light and dark), bongIT logo instead of the Unraid wordmark, tidy dashboard tiles, dialogs, tables and plugin pages. - Settings page (Settings → bongIT Theme) in German.
Requires Unraid 7.4.1 or newer.
